A report to the Administrative Conference of the United States in 2021 
on “mass, malattributed, and computer-generated comments” concluded 
“that agencies should adopt both low- and high-tech measures to limit the 
negative impact of these sorts of comments,” adding that such comments 
“do not represent a crisis for the regulatory state at this time. They have 
not been found to violate federal law and do not generally undArmine the 
integrity of notice-and-comment rule making, and we are not aware of
